archetype: Electric & Neon (Future, Speed, Disruption) tailored for Tech Competition

rules: No Inter or generic fonts for headings.
Overlines MUST be uppercase + tiny + tracking-[0.2em].
Fluid scaling for heroes: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl max.
Use JetBrains Mono for leaderboard points, countdown timers, and code editors.

visual_enhancers.grid_borders: border-collapse style, child items have border-r border-b border-border/40
visual_enhancers.retro_terminal: scanlines overlay (CSS repeating-linear-gradient), subtle glow on active code lines
visual_enhancers.hover_states: explicit text color on hover. Buttons lift (-translate-y-1) + shadow-lg.

landing_page.rules: Wide gaps (gap-8 to gap-12). Huge Unbounded typography. Marquee with 'THINK. CREATE. SOLVE. CODE.' in kinetic texture.
landing_page.hero_overlay: bg-black/50 maximum. Use gradient to transparent.

dashboard_student.rules: Tight gaps (gap-4). Every pixel utilized. Grid children must stretch to match neighbors. Sidebar for navigation.

code_editor.rules: Left: Problem/File tree. Center: Editor (Scratch or Java). Bottom: Terminal/Output. Use absolute/flex layouts to fill viewport height (100vh - header).

Custom: JavaEditor (Monaco Editor or CodeMirror implementation wrapper)

rules: Use framer-motion for page transitions and leaderboard shuffling.
Smooth stagger effects for list items in leaderboard.
Include data-testid on all interactive elements (e.g. data-testid='login-button', data-testid='run-code-button').

hero_background.description: Abstract cyber technology background with lights, perfect for landing page hero.

about_competition.description: Group of students working at desks, used for 'About the Event' section.

diversity_students.description: Students collaborating in a computer lab.

code_visual.description: Computer screen showing code, decorative visual for CodeMasters round.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like robot, brain, lightbulb, target, etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it.
For the code editor, implement a 3-pane layout. It should feel like a modern IDE (sidebar, editor, terminal).
